vulnerability_analysis: The contract allows the owner to set the marketing wallet address and control the percentage of liquidity fees directed to marketing. By setting marketing wallet to attacker address and percentage to 100%, all swap fees will be sent to attacker. Combined with ability to trigger swapAndLiquify via normal transfers, this allows owner to drain accumulated BNB from the contract.
attack_strategy: Impersonate owner, set attacker as marketing wallet, set marketing percentage to 100%, ensure contract has token balance above minimum threshold, then trigger swapAndLiquify via a transfer to capture all BNB fees.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Use vm.prank to impersonate current owner
2. Call setMarketingWallet(attacker)
3. Call setPercentageOfLiquidityForMarketing(100)
4. Optionally lower _minTokenBalance for easier triggering
5. Transfer tokens to generate fees in contract
6. Make another transfer to trigger swapAndLiquify
7. Collect BNB sent to marketing wallet (attacker)
